failures.contract: (b) Lines. "Only the first 512000 bytes (500 KiB, section 2.5; lane reading: exactly this limit) of the file are read; a leading UTF-8 byte order mark (EF BB BF) is dropped; the rest is decoded as UTF-8 with invalid bytes becoming U+FFFD. Lines end at CR, LF or CRLF. On each line everything from the first # is a comment and removed. A line without : is ignored. The key is the text before the first : with spaces and tabs trimmed, compared ASCII case-insensitively; the value is the text after it with spaces and tabs trimmed. Keys user-agent, allow and disallow are records; every other key (for example sitemap, crawl-delay) is ignored and does not end a group (section 2.2.4). An allow or disallow line before the first user-agent line is ignored (section 2.2.2)."
